faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha (Bolangir WCD Odisha) for Saintala city locations under advertisement number 1727.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The available post under this notification is Anganwadi Sahayika, which is an honorarium-based contract government job opportunity located in Odisha.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for this recruitment cycle across different posts and locations in the Saintala region of Bolangir district.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have successfully passed the Class 7 (+9) or equivalent examination from a recognized board to be eligible for the Anganwadi Sahayika position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 44 years of age as on the specified reference date of 01-01-2021 to apply for the openings.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for Bolangir WCD Odisha recruitment is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can eligible candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official engagement portal, filling out the form, uploading documents, and submitting hard copies to the CDPO office.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official notification released by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preparing a merit list based on the marks secured in the Class 7 (+9) examination, alongside additional weightage for specific categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details and access the direct application links in the Important Links section of this recruitment article.
